Use a hook with "--date-fallback" followed by a quoted 2026-11-16 day. Run date-pin refresh and continuation validation with a 2026-11-17 merge day.
Preparation refreshes or restores each recognized option, and continuation refuses stale pins before publication.
The verifier accepts the shell option. The workflow leaves the stale day in place, and the continuation guard reports no mismatch.
